scope: Read-only current accepted source audit; no engine/native/profiler/build launches or source edits.

families.existing_reuse: Water, vertex and per-swim movement snapshots shared; equal movement profiles interned; prepared cost tables reused.
families.dependencies: Terrain rules, registry, swim class, modified costs and edit lifetime. In-batch changes reset frozen snapshots before the batch terrain generation advances.

families.family: Immutable world components and published field planes
families.existing_reuse: Generation-matched components reused; pooled buffers copy changed chunks relative to their own stamps. Published plane key + generation shares immutable values.
families.dependencies: World identity, dimensions, configuration/terrain/catalog generations, component/chunk stamps and individual plane generation. Pooled address or tick alone is insufficient.

families.existing_reuse: Incremental map seed cache and per-worker immutable-snapshot seed cache already reuse base terrain/resource/building/team templates, with bounded fallback.
families.dependencies: Terrain/resource/occupancy/area stamps, world/catalog identities, material availability and immobile/building signatures. Visibility, supplier stock/policy, costs, consumer exclusion and live overlays are not interchangeable with the base template.

families.family: Natural, market and consumer material fields
families.existing_reuse: Shared natural unreachable planes and consumer-specific cached fields; supplier preparation and base seed reuse.
families.dependencies: Team/material/swim/mode/consumer key; stock revision; topology; consumer script identity/type/position; 128-tick age and deterministic recency/eviction. Age and cache metadata are simulation-visible, so a byte-identical rebuild is not automatically removable.

families.existing_reuse: Private incremental search settles needed cost layers; existing fields remain until scheduled publication; full-field completion retained for save/read contracts.
families.dependencies: Building script identity and refresh epoch; team/route/swim, footprint/goals/range/permissions/resources/immobile occupants; frozen movement costs, topology and age. Whole equal-cost layers must settle for equal-distance direction selection.

families.existing_reuse: Round-robin periodic field work; forbidden partition comparison avoids rebuilding unchanged obstacle/goal partitions.
families.dependencies: Capture tick, publication deadline, topology, epochs and request order. Cost-only terrain changes force refresh even where the forbidden partition is unchanged. Observers must see publication at the prescribed boundary.

families.existing_reuse: Ground fields already keyed by team/swim/escape-forbidden; flyers share one field. Separate ground/air invalidation and bounded 64 MiB LRU. Moving occupancy tested at descent rather than included in propagated field.
families.dependencies: Terrain walk/fly/swim/health/entry costs, resource blocking, buildings, own-team forbidden mask. Current forbidden changes invalidate the entire ground generation, even for other teams.

families.existing_reuse: Bounded weak-owner cache by immutable terrain source/dimensions/swim/revision/modified state; canonicalizes concurrent cold constructions on insertion.
families.dependencies: Immutable owner lifetime, host budget and cancellation semantics. Two simultaneous misses may construct the same view before the second locked lookup.
families.classification: Source-proven possible duplicate preparation, not measured frequency or CPU cost; GPU-specific path cannot be justified by forthcoming GPU-off attribution.

conclusion: Existing reuse is substantial. No source audit proves wholesale propagated fields can be skipped safely. Identical plane bytes or heap plane-equivalents do not establish identical dependencies, search frontier, ownership, publication or simulation-visible cache state.

one_conditional_candidate.status: Conditional audit proposal only; no patch/build/test added
one_conditional_candidate.mechanism: Narrow only terrain-safety ground permission invalidation by changed team bits, keeping global terrain/building/resource-blocking invalidation and existing caches.
one_conditional_candidate.reason: EscapeProfile.initialCost reads only profile.team forbidden bits. A permission edit exclusively for team A cannot alter the propagated safety cost plane for team B if all other inputs are unchanged. Current global groundGeneration discards both.
one_conditional_candidate.not_claimed: No evidence this family dominates accepted Oazis late CPU, nor that false invalidations occur enough to matter. Do not optimize until observed leaf attribution and bounded miss-reason evidence support it.
one_conditional_candidate.gate: Continuous perf shows buildEscapeField/pathfindTerrainSafety materially hot; diagnostics establish unrelated-team forbidden edits cause significant rebuilds. No new profile cohort requested.
implementation_risks: All mutation paths must supply old XOR new team bits, including replaceTile and bulk edits; unknown edits retain conservative all-team invalidation.
Preserve air invalidation for terrain/resource blocking and all ground invalidation for terrain/buildings/blocking resources.
Preserve wrap/reset/load/registry changes, bounded LRU, exact directions and tie order. No changes to global topology, scheduled fields, epochs, publication, cache save/checksum metadata.
tests: Affected team rebuild and unchanged other-team exact field/direction reuse for single/multi-bit add/remove/replaceTile edits.
Terrain/cost/health/swim/building/resource blocking edits invalidate all relevant fields; stock-only changes retain cache; flyers ignore permission edits.
Moving/immobile occupancy and forbidden escape mode, rectangular torus, query order, LRU eviction, generation wrap and map/world/load resets.
Exact per-tick world/GCS/RNG, replay payload and save continuation for multi-team routed games, all existing safety fixtures plus varied maps/classes/platform coverage.

prior_control_limits: Depth/retention controls trade CPU, wall and storage; K1 periodic/chunk and K3 FIFO candidates did not establish adopted benefits. Snapshot ownership V1/V2 changes rejected; unchanged published-plane sharing already existed. These controls do not show safely redundant work in a particular field family.
perf_status: Continuous privileged CPU sampling queued; no actual late sample evidence assumed. Statistical GPU-off attribution must include workers, exclusive leaf ownership and unknown/library/kernel buckets.
followup: No speculative cache implementation. Await existing continuous attribution; reject this optional candidate if safety escape fields are not material.
